description: This file is the main entry point of a Flutter mobile application, defining the root widget MyApp and the home page widget MyHomePage. It sets up basic app theming and a simple scaffold with a centered message and progress indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: The root widget of the application, setting up the MaterialApp with a title, theme, and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the home screen, displaying a title passed via constructor.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: The state class for MyHomePage, building a Scaffold with AppBar and centered content including a message and progress indicator.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The application's entry point that initializes and runs the Flutter app by instantiating MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and _MyHomePageState, defining UI structure.
